title: The Rainbow Token Approval

captures.note: approve + swap batched in one tx
dry: stopped at the confirm screen

_comment: Selling 1 USDC → ETH in Rainbow's Swap, on an account Rainbow had already turned into a smart wallet (RBS delegated it to Calibur). No separate approval screen and no separate approval tx: ONE transaction, a call from the account to itself (Calibur batch-execute 0x99e1d016), that approves EXACTLY 1 USDC to RainbowRouter 0x0000…10e2 (Sourcify: RainbowRouter) and runs the swap in the same tx. You never see 'approve' as its own step. No server call was new compared with the ETH→USDC swap. Tx 0x0a70ffcdf1d543a3a4d2aa335177e1fef25a12a1334dda2d23bca76627921b83.
